summary: [Asana] rate-limits (per https://developers.asana.com/docs/rate-limits): 150 req/min free, 1,500/min paid; 50 concurrent GET / 15 concurrent writes; Search 60/min separate; duplication/export 5 concurrent/user; cost-based throttling on heavy graph traversals; 429 with Retry-After; per-token allocation.
